entity: Ospita – Die Schweizer Gesundheitsunternehmen (association of private/independent healthcare providers)
detail: President of the Ospita association, representing Swiss private/independent healthcare companies. Listed among his registered interest bindings as a Ständerat. Described in reporting as a lucrative mandate.

entity: IRF Reputation AG (communications / public affairs agency), Zurich
detail: Employed as a public affairs / communications consultant. His parliamentary interest declaration lists the employer but not the agency's clients, which he has declined to disclose.

entity: Ost – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule (Eastern Switzerland University of Applied Sciences)
detail: Member of the governing council of the university of applied sciences OST; listed among his interest bindings.

role: Member of the board of directors (Verwaltungsrat)
detail: Served on the board of the Glarner Kantonalbank, initially (2021–2024) as the cantonal government's representative, then for a one-year transitional period as an independent member following the death of board chairman Martin Leutenegger. Did not stand for re-election in 2025; succeeded by Angela Petruzzi.

role: Member of the board of directors (Verwaltungsrat)
